ideas.pitch: An automated data cleaning and imputation toolkit built specifically for fast-paced crisis survival sprints.
ideas.title: CrisisPulse Streamlined Cleaning Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon features a strict cross-domain data survival sprint with a data cleaning phase, having an accelerated, reliable cleaning script directly maximizes early phase scores.

ideas.pitch: A modular dashboard generator that instantly translates messy multi-domain CSV data into executive-ready crisis metrics.
ideas.title: RapidBoard Executive Crisis Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a live, working product that directly addresses the crisis dashboard building phase and appeals to industry judges looking for clear executive insights.

ideas.pitch: An automated Kaggle-style predictive modeling pipeline with built-in SHAP values for instant model interpretability during executive pitches.
ideas.title: XGB-Explain Clinical & Crisis Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high predictive accuracy with clinical and executive explainability, mirroring winning projects that rely on SHAP for transparent judging.

ideas.pitch: A rapid diagnostic tool to detect and mitigate dataset and model bias before submitting predictions to the leaderboard.
ideas.title: AutoAudit Bias & Fairness Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in data science competitions increasingly value robust, fair, and unbiased models over purely overfitted metrics.
